{{Quote|I once played a tramp freighter captain in "Captain Rygaen's Ploy," but I never expected I'd actually become one.|Rollo Morsai|<ref name="GG6-1" />}}
'''Rollo Morsai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and former [[Actor/Legends|actress]] who operated in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] during the time of the [[Rebellion era]].

==Biography==
Formerly a beautiful [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilm]] actress under the name "Jona Reeten," she was blacklisted by [[Babel Torsch]] when he learned she had played the role of a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] in a holo set during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Unable to find work as an entertainer, she converted her yacht ''[[Gilded Lily]]'' to a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and started smuggling.

==Personality and traits==
Gaunt and lethargic from inactivity and despair, Rollo was prone to depression and focused on getting revenge on [[Babel Torsch]]. [[Tiebo]], her pilot and former valet, performed most of the work for her business.

Over time she had come to accept her turn of fortunes without too much bitterness. Despite this, her outlook on life was a fatalist one, believing that her future was going to reserve her much more pain.
